test_title: PYST 64: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a code language, 'DILIP' is coded as 46-36-30-36-22 and 'PRINCE' is coded as 22-18-36-26-48-44. How will 'FIROZ' be coded in the same language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f1010bb97fa3c69ed24a3e1b80794aa5de1719501dd087f0a78a645a2eaa06f.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Logic: **Letters are getting Opposite then multiply by 2 on its positional value.**

Now,

'DILIP' is coded as 46-36-30-36-22

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1c39c0d2cdabf3696903fc2d8a324a59edba8976c02cb7d413088a0164af5e4.png] 

 'PRINCE' is coded as 22-18-36-26-48-44

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/220c60f7667c7a09544b42faf48d5bf804e9fb2a1224185cd55472e89f762e34.png] 

Similarly,** for 'FIROZ'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/faba33171036257e83f0109c20dbf8e78e0d91cc959f066300b6c268b0580f36.png] 

So, 'FIROZ' will be coded as '42-36-18-24-2'

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
